name: @ajour/desktop
description: Ajour desktop app for local-first time tracking.
author: Ajour

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "corepack pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @ajour/web dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort --mode desktop" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && AJOUR_DESKTOP_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron ."
scripts.start: node scripts/run-renderer.cjs build && node scripts/run-renderer.cjs start
